1. Kneel tall facing a wall with a med ball at one hip
2. Rotate and scoop it into the wall as hard as you can
3. Let it go, then reset
4. Repeat

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
intensive tall kneeling medball overhead:
Steps
1. Kneel tall facing a wall holding a med ball overhead
2. Throw it into the wall as hard as you can
3. Let it go, then reset
4. Repeat

Tip
Max effort. Reset between reps.
intensive tall kneeling medball rotation:
Steps
1. Kneel tall side-on to a wall with a med ball at your back hip
2. Rotate and scoop it into the wall as hard as you can
3. Catch it and go straight into the next rep
4. Keep going

Tip
Max effort, repeated.
isometric adductor ball squeeze:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and a ball between your knees
2. Squeeze the ball as hard as you can
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Keep breathing.
isometric med ball squeeze:
Steps
1. Hold a med ball between your hands or knees
2. Crush the ball as hard as you can
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Keep breathing.
jefferson curl:
Steps
1. Stand on a box holding a light weight with straight arms
2. Tuck your chin and roll down one segment of your spine at a time
3. Let the weight lower towards your feet as far as you comfortably can
4. Roll back up one segment at a time

Tip
Start very light. Slow and controlled.
jump rope:
Steps
1. Hold the handles at hip height with your elbows close to your sides
2. Turn the rope with your wrists
3. Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing on the balls of your feet
4. Keep a steady rhythm

Tip
Small, quick jumps.
keiser split stance push & pull:
Steps
1. Set the handles at chest height and stand in a split stance
2. Push one handle forward while pulling the other back
3. Switch arms quickly
4. Repeat

Tip
Be aggressive with each rep.
keiser standing hip abduction:
Steps
1. Attach the ankle strap to the outside leg and stand side-on
2. Hold a dowel or the machine for balance
3. Lift your leg out to the side
4. Return slowly

Tip
Stand tall and don't lean.
keiser standing hip flexion:
Steps
1. Attach the ankle strap and face away from the machine
2. Hold something for balance
3. Drive your knee up towards your chest
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Stay tall.
keiser standing thoracic rotation with b:
Steps
1. Stand side-on holding the bar attached to the machine
2. Wind up towards the machine as far as you can
3. Rotate through your upper back away from the machine
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your chest up as you rotate.
keiser supine leg adduction:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with the ankle strap on the leg closest to the machine
2. Start with that leg out to the side
3. Pull it across towards the midline
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your hips flat.
keiser tricep extension:
Steps
1. Attach a handle and face the machine
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push down until your arms are straight
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
keiser triceps extension - rope attachme:
Steps
1. Attach a rope and face the machine
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push the rope down and spread the ends at the bottom
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
keiser triceps pushdown - trx attachment:
Steps
1. Attach the TRX handles and face the machine
2. Tuck your elbows at your sides
3. Push down until your arms are straight
4. Return slowly

Tip
Only the forearms move.
kettlebell bottom up carry - double arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell upside down in each hand, elbows at 90 degrees
2. Squeeze the handles to balance the bells
3. Walk slowly for the set distance or time
4. Keep your wrists straight

Tip
Keep your shoulders down.
kettlebell bottom up wiper:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell upside down, elbow at 90 degrees
2. Keep your elbow still and rotate your forearm side to side
3. Keep the bell balanced throughout
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Elbow stays at 90 degrees.
kettlebell farmers carry:
Steps
1. Pick up a kettlebell in each hand with a flat back
2. Stand tall with your shoulders down
3. Walk with short, controlled steps
4. Put the bells down with a flat back

Tip
Don't let the bells swing.
kettlebell grip hold:
Steps
1. Pick up a heavy kettlebell in each hand
2. Stand tall with your arms straight
3. Hold for the set time
4. Put them down with a flat back

Tip
Squeeze the handles hard.
kettlebell hammer curl - double arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell by the horns or handle in each hand, palms facing in
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Elbows by your sides.
kettlebell hammer curl - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell in one hand, palm facing in
2. Curl it up towards your shoulder
3. Lower slowly
4. Switch arms after the set

Tip
Elbow by your side.
kettlebell hip flexor iso hold:
Steps
1. Sit or stand with a kettlebell hanging from your foot or resting on your thigh
2. Lift your knee to 90 degrees
3. Hold it there for the set time
4. Lower and switch sides

Tip
Stay tall.
kettlebell hip flexor raise:
Steps
1. Sit or stand with a kettlebell hanging from your foot or resting on your thigh
2. Lift your knee to 90 degrees
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch sides

Tip
Stay tall.
kettlebell rack + suitcase carry:
Steps
1. Hold one kettlebell in the rack position at your shoulder and another at your side
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk for the set distance or time
4. Switch sides

Tip
Don't sway as you walk.
kettlebell rack carry:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at each shoulder
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk with short, controlled steps
4. Keep your elbows tucked

Tip
Don't lean back.
kettlebell rack carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk with short, controlled steps
4. Switch sides

Tip
Don't lean to either side.
kettlebell radial deviation:
Steps
1. Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle, arm at your side
2. Tilt your hand up at the wrist (thumb side)
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your arm still.
kettlebell tibialis raise:
Steps
1. Sit on a bench with a kettlebell hooked over the top of your foot, heel on the floor
2. Let your toes drop to stretch the front of your shin
3. Pull your toes up towards your knee as far as you can
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a stretch at the bottom of each rep.
kettlebell towel neck flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Place a folded towel on your forehead and hold a light kettlebell on it with both hands
3. Bring your chin towards your chest
4. Lower slowly back to level

Tip
Light load and smooth reps. Keep the weight steady with your hands.
kettlebell wrist extension - double hand:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell by the handle with both hands, palms down, forearms resting on your thighs
2. Let your wrists drop down
3. Lift the backs of your hands up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Can be done seated. Forearms stay still.
lateral crossover step:
Steps
1. Stand in an athletic stance, side-on to where you're going
2. Drive your trailing knee across your body
3. Push hard off the inside foot and step across
4. Land balanced and reset

Tip
Fast knee punch across the body.
lateral leg swing:
Steps
1. Face a wall with your hands on it for support
2. Swing one leg across in front of your body, then out to the side
3. Gradually increase the range
4. Switch legs

Tip
Keep your trunk still. The swing comes from the hip.
lower calf stretch:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance with both hands on the wall
2. Bend both knees, keeping the back heel on the floor
3. Lean in until you feel a stretch low in the back calf
4. Hold, then switch legs

Tip
The bent knee targets the lower calf (soleus).
lying dumbbell tricep extension - double:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in
2. Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your elbows fixed and pointing up.
lying piriformis stretch:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with both knees bent
2. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee
3. Pull the bottom thigh towards your chest
4. Hold, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
machine seated calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad on your thighs
2. Release the safety
3. Let your heels drop for a stretch, then rise as high as you can
4. Pause at the top and lower slowly

Tip
Push through the big toe.
machine seated single leg calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit in the machine with one foot on the platform and the pad on that thigh
2. Release the safety
3. Let your heel drop, then rise as high as you can
4. Pause at the top and lower slowly, then switch legs

Tip
Push through the big toe.
machine standing 2 up 1 down calf raise:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine on the balls of both feet with the pads on your shoulders
2. Rise up with both legs
3. Take one foot off and lower slowly on the other leg
4. Put the foot back and repeat

Tip
Push off the ball of your big toe.
machine standing calf raise - single leg:
Steps
1. Stand in the machine on the ball of one foot, pads on your shoulders
2. Let your heel drop for a stretch
3. Rise as high as you can
4. Lower slowly, then switch legs

Tip
Push through the ball of the big toe.
mcgill curl up:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight
2. Slide your hands under the arch of your lower back
3. Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor without bending your neck
4. Hold for 5 to 10 seconds, then lower

Tip
Keep tension through the abs the whole time. Switch the bent leg halfway.
mini band clamshell:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with a mini band above your knees, hips and knees bent
2. Keep your feet together
3. Lift your top knee as high as you can without rolling back
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Keep your hips stacked.
mini band glute bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with a mini band above your knees, feet flat
2. Push your knees out against the band
3. Drive through your heels to lift your hips
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower

Tip
Keep your knees pushed out the whole time.
mini band lateral squat walk (ankles):
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your ankles
2. Sit into a quarter squat
3. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band
4. Take the set number of steps, then go the other way

Tip
Stay low and don't let your feet come together.
mini band lateral squat walk (knees):
Steps
1. Place a mini band just above your knees
2. Sit into a quarter squat
3. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band
4. Take the set number of steps, then go the other way

Tip
Stay low and keep your knees pushed out.
mini band squat:
Steps
1. Place a mini band just above your knees
2. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart
3. Squat down, pushing your knees out against the band
4. Stand up, keeping the knees out

Tip
Don't let your knees cave in.
miniband - serratus lift:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists and your forearms on a wall
2. Push your wrists apart against the band
3. Slide your forearms up the wall
4. Lift them slightly off the wall at the top, then return

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
miniband eversion:
Steps
1. Sit with a mini band around your feet, heels on the floor
2. Keep one foot still
3. Turn the other foot outwards against the band
4. Return slowly, then switch

Tip
Move only at the ankle.
miniband external rotation + iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Set your shoulder blades down and back
3. Rotate your forearms out against the band and hold for the set time
4. Return slowly

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband external rotation iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Set your shoulder blades down and back
3. Pull your hands apart and hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
miniband hip flexion - wall leaning:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your feet and lean your back against a wall
2. Stand on one leg
3. Drive the other knee up to hip height against the band
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Stay tall against the wall.
miniband shoulder abduction:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists
2. Stand tall with arms by your sides
3. Lift one arm out to the side against the band
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Keep your shoulder down away from your ear.
miniband shoulder external rotation:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your wrists, elbows tucked at 90 degrees
2. Rotate one forearm out against the band
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Elbows stay pinned to your sides.
natera ankle iso ballistic:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar or in a calf raise machine on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
2. Push up into the bar hard
3. Perform small, rapid bounces against the bar from that position
4. Keep the heel high throughout, then switch legs

Tip
Small range, maximum speed.
natera ankle iso push:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
2. Push up into the bar as hard as you can
3. Hold the effort for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
This can be swapped for a standing calf raise machine or a Smith machine.
natera ankle iso switch:
Steps
1. Set up under a fixed bar on the balls of your feet in a sprint stance, heels just off the floor
2. Push into the bar
3. Quickly switch your legs, keeping the heels high
4. Repeat for the set reps

Tip
Don't let your heels drop as you switch.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - hammer:
Steps
1. Stand in the calf raise machine on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent
2. Lift the load until your heel is just off the platform
3. Hold that position for the set time without letting the heel sink
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. The aim is to resist the weight, not lift it.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - hand su:
Steps
1. Put a safety bar on your back and hold a rack for support
2. Stand on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent, heel just off the floor
3. Hold that position for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. Don't let the heel sink.
natera yielding ankle iso hold - smith m:
Steps
1. Set the Smith bar on your back and stand on the ball of one foot, knee slightly bent
2. Lift the heel just off the floor
3. Hold that position for the set time
4. Rest, then switch legs

Tip
Hold still. Don't let the heel sink.
neck circles off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on a bench with your head and neck off the end
2. Slowly draw a big circle with your head
3. Complete the reps, then circle the other way
4. Keep your shoulders on the bench

Tip
If your neck pinches in a spot, draw a smaller circle.
neck extension:
Steps
1. Hinge forward or lie face down with your head free
2. Lower your chin towards your chest
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Smooth reps through a comfortable range.
neck extension iso hold with weight plat:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on the back of your head with both hands
3. Keep your head in line with your spine
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Start light. Keep breathing.
neck extension off bench:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head fold forward for a stretch
3. Lift your head back until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a big stretch at the bottom.
neck flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your back or sit tall
2. Tuck your chin
3. Bring your chin towards your chest
4. Return slowly

Tip
Smooth reps through a comfortable range.
neck flexion iso hold with weight plate:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on your forehead with both hands
3. Keep your head level with your body
4. Hold for the set time

Tip
Start light. Keep breathing.
neck flexion off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head lower back for a stretch
3. Pull your chin towards your collarbone
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Get a big stretch at the bottom of each rep.
neck lateral flexion off bench:
Steps
1. Lie on your side on a bench with your head off the end
2. Let your head lower towards the floor
3. Lift your ear towards your top shoulder
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Get a big stretch between reps.
overhead dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides
2. Raise them out to the sides, past shoulder height, until they meet overhead
3. Lower slowly the same way
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your ribs down so your back doesn't arch.
overhead plate double switch:
Steps
1. Hold a plate overhead with straight arms
2. Stand in the A position: one knee up at hip height, standing on the ball of the other foot
3. Switch legs twice quickly
4. Hold the A position, then repeat

Tip
Stay tall with the plate overhead.
overhead plate single leg switch:
Steps
1. Hold a plate overhead with straight arms
2. Stand in the A position: one knee up at hip height, standing on the ball of the other foot
3. Switch legs once quickly and hold
4. Repeat

Tip
Stay upright.
partial dumbbell lateral raise:
Steps
1. Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Raise them out to the sides through the bottom half of the range only
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep constant tension. Don't rest at the bottom.
pinch grip drop catch:
Steps
1. Hold a plate in a pinch grip at your side
2. Let go of it
3. Catch it in a pinch grip before it hits the floor
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Use a light plate and keep your feet clear.
pinch grip drop catch - alternating:
Steps
1. Hold a plate in a pinch grip in one hand
2. Drop it and catch it with the other hand
3. Keep alternating hands
4. Catch it before it hits the floor

Tip
Use a light plate and keep your feet clear.
pinch grip dumbbell hammer curls:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells by the end of the head in a pinch grip, palms facing in
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep the pinch tight throughout.
plate genie external rotation - barbell:
Steps
1. Set a barbell in the rack at or just below shoulder height
2. Rest your upper arm on the bar, elbow at 90 degrees, holding a light plate
3. Rotate your forearm up until it points to the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Elbow stays on the bar.
plate neck extension:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on the back of your head
3. Lift your head until it's in line with your spine
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Start light.
plate neck flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on your forehead
3. Bring your chin towards your chest
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Start light.
plate neck lateral flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your side on a bench with your head off the end
2. Hold a plate on the side of your head
3. Lift your ear towards your top shoulder
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Start light.
plate pinch grip hold:
Steps
1. Pinch one or more plates together with your fingertips and thumb
2. Stand tall with your arm by your side
3. Hold for the set time
4. Switch hands

Tip
Squeeze as hard as you can.
powerband overhead tricep extension - hi:
Steps
1. Anchor a band high and face away, holding it behind your head
2. Point your elbows forward
3. Extend your arms forward until they're straight
4. Bend your elbows slowly to return

Tip
Stagger your stance and keep your ribs down.
powerband shrug:
Steps
1. Stand on a band and hold the ends at your sides
2. Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Shoulders up and back.
prone back extension t's:
Steps
1. Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades together
3. Lift your chest and arms off the floor
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
prone band behind the neck lat pull down:
Steps
1. Lie face down holding a band overhead with your hands wide
2. Lift your arms and chest slightly off the floor
3. Pull the band down behind your head towards your upper back
4. Return slowly overhead

Tip
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
prone bench shoulder ball drop catch:
Steps
1. Lie face down on a bench with one arm hanging, holding a small ball
2. Lift your arm out in front
3. Drop the ball and quickly catch it
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Can use a tennis ball, lacrosse ball or small sandbag.
prone dart:
Steps
1. Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms facing in
2. Pull your shoulder blades back and down
3. Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor
4. Hold briefly, then lower

Tip
Shoulder blades away from your ears.
prone db arm extension:
Steps
1. Lie face down with light dumbbells, arms by your sides, palms up
2. Set your shoulder blades back and down
3. Lift the dumbbells up towards the ceiling with straight arms
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Small range. Lead with the shoulder blades.
prone external rotation exercise:
Steps
1. Lie face down with your arm out to the side, elbow bent at 90 degrees over the edge of a bench
2. Hold a light dumbbell
3. Rotate your forearm up until it's level with your body
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulder away from your ear.
prone incline bench w raise:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells
2. Bend your elbows and pull them back into a W shape
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades together
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your chest on the pad.
prone shoulder external rotation pails &:
Steps
1. Lie face down with your arm out to the side, elbow at 90 degrees, at the end of your external rotation range
2. Press your forearm down into a fixed surface for 10 seconds (PAILs)
3. Then actively lift it up away from the surface for 10 seconds (RAILs)
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Keep your shoulder away from your ear and your wrist straight.
prone y lift off - alternating:
Steps
1. Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up
2. Lift one arm off the floor
3. Lower it and lift the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
quadruped neck lateral iso hold:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with your head in line with your spine
2. Press your hand against the side of your head
3. Resist with your neck so your head doesn't move
4. Hold for the set time, then switch sides

Tip
Steady pressure. Keep breathing.
quadruped shoulder tap:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees just off the floor
2. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
3. Put it down and repeat on the other side
4. Keep your hips level

Tip
Your hips shouldn't move. Add load on your upper back to make it harder.
quadruped shoulder tap - grounded:
Steps
1. Start on hands and knees with your knees on the floor
2. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
3. Put it down and repeat on the other side
4. Keep your back flat

Tip
Your hips shouldn't rock.
reverse lunge:
Steps
1. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart
2. Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees
3. Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes
4. Push through the front foot to step back to the start

Tip
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side.
roman chair hip adduction:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with your top leg on the Roman chair pad and bottom leg free
2. Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line
3. Lift your bottom leg up to meet the top one
4. Lower slowly, then switch sides

Tip
Work within a comfortable range.
rotating side plank:
Steps
1. Start in a side plank on your elbow
2. Reach your top arm to the ceiling
3. Rotate and thread that arm under your body
4. Rotate back to the start

Tip
Keep your hips up the whole time.
running:
Steps
1. Warm up with a few minutes of easy jogging
2. Run at the pace or intensity prescribed
3. Stay tall with relaxed shoulders and quick, light steps
4. Finish with a few minutes of easy jogging or walking

Tip
Land under your hips, not out in front.
seated dumbbell alternating iso lateral:
Steps
1. Sit tall holding dumbbells
2. Raise both out to the sides to shoulder height
3. Hold one there while you lower and raise the other
4. Keep alternating

Tip
Lead with your elbows.
seated dumbbell bicep curl:
Steps
1. Sit tall on a bench holding dumbbells at your sides
2. Curl them up towards your shoulders
3. Squeeze at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Don't lean back.
seated dumbbell calf raise:
Steps
1. Sit with the balls of your feet on a plate or step and dumbbells on your knees
2. Let your heels drop
3. Rise as high as you can
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Come up onto the ball of your big toe.
seated dumbbell cuban press:
Steps
1. Sit tall holding light dumbbells at your sides
2. Row them up until your elbows are at shoulder height
3. Rotate your forearms up
4. Press overhead, then reverse each step

Tip
Use a light weight.
seated dumbbell shoulder external rotati:
Steps
1. Sit tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees
2. Rotate your forearm out away from your body
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
A rolled towel between your elbow and ribs helps.

Steps
1. Sit side-on to an incline bench and rest your upper arm on it at shoulder height
2. Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell
3. Rotate your forearm up
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Elbow stays on the pad.
seated ez bar overhead triceps extension:
Steps
1. Sit tall holding an EZ bar overhead with a close grip
2. Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head
3. Extend your arms back to straight
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
seated piriformis stretch:
Steps
1. Sit tall on a chair or bench
2. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee
3. Lean forward from the hips with a flat back
4. Hold, then switch sides

Tip
Lean until you feel a stretch in the buttock.
seated plate front raise:
Steps
1. Sit tall holding a plate at the sides with both hands
2. Raise it forward to shoulder height with straight arms
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Don't lean back.
seated straight bar cable preacher curl:
Steps
1. Sit at a preacher bench in front of a low cable with a straight bar
2. Rest your upper arms on the pad
3. Curl the bar up towards your shoulders
4. Lower slowly to almost straight

Tip
Keep your arms on the pad.
shoulder tap:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with your hands under your shoulders
2. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
3. Put it down and repeat on the other side
4. Keep your hips level

Tip
Widen your feet to make it easier.
side lying thoracic rotation:
Steps
1. Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms out in front
2. Lift your top arm and rotate it across to the other side
3. Follow your hand with your eyes
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your knees together on the floor.
single arm band lower y pulls:
Steps
1. Anchor a band high in front of you, holding it in one hand
2. Pull the band down and out into a low Y
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your collarbones wide and shoulders away from your ears.
single arm band shoulder extension + abd:
Steps
1. Anchor a band in front of you at chest height
2. Pull your straight arm down to your side
3. Then lift it out to the side
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulder down.
single arm band t pulls:
Steps
1. Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height
2. Pull one hand out to the side into a T
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your arm straight and shoulder down.
single arm bar hang:
Steps
1. Grab a pull-up bar with one hand
2. Let your body hang with your arm straight
3. Hold for the set time
4. Switch hands

Tip
Use chalk if needed.
single arm reverse grip tricep pushdown:
Steps
1. Anchor a band high and hold it with one hand, palm up
2. Tuck your elbow at your side
3. Push down until your arm is straight
4. Return slowly, then switch

Tip
Only the forearm moves.
single leg glute bridge:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight
2. Drive through your heel to lift your hips
3. Keep your hips level at the top
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Don't let your hips tilt.
single leg skater squat:
Steps
1. Stand on one leg
2. Bend your knee and reach the other knee back towards the floor
3. Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor
4. Drive through the front foot to stand

Tip
Reach your arms forward for balance.
split stance banded first step hip proje:
Steps
1. Put a band around your hips with tension from behind
2. Stand in a split stance
3. Take one aggressive step forward, driving your hips forward
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Get good tension on the band.
split stance deadball load & rip:
Steps
1. Hold a deadball at your hips in a split stance
2. Pull it in towards your hips as you load into your hips
3. Explode up, ripping the ball up
4. Pull it back in and repeat

Tip
Load the hips, then be explosive.
sprint:
Steps
1. Warm up thoroughly first
2. Start from the position prescribed
3. Accelerate as hard as you can over the set distance
4. Walk back and rest fully before the next rep

Tip
Stay tall and drive your arms.
stability ball tuck:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with your shins on a stability ball
2. Pull your knees in towards your chest, rolling the ball forward
3. Push back out to straight legs
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your hips level.
standing cable external rotation + upper:
Steps
1. Set a cable at elbow height beside you, holding it in the far hand, elbow tucked
2. Rotate your forearm out
3. Then press up in an uppercut path overhead
4. Reverse slowly

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
standing cable hip flexion:
Steps
1. Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and face away
2. Hold something for balance
3. Drive your knee up towards your chest
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Stay tall.
standing cable internal rotation + upper:
Steps
1. Set a cable at elbow height beside you, holding it in the near hand, elbow tucked
2. Rotate your forearm in
3. Then press up in an uppercut path overhead
4. Reverse slowly

Tip
Keep your ribs down as you press.
standing cable lateral side raise:
Steps
1. Set a cable low and stand side-on, holding the handle in the far hand
2. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your chest up and don't lean back.
standing dumbbell calf raise:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, balls of your feet on a step if you have one
2. Rise as high as you can
3. Pause at the top
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Put your weight on the ball of the big toe.
standing isometric shoulder abduction on:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall, elbow bent and the outside of your elbow against it
2. Push your elbow out into the wall
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Push as hard as your shoulder tolerates with no more than mild pain.
standing isometric shoulder external rot:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall or doorframe, elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees, back of the hand against it
2. Push your hand out into the wall
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Push as hard as your shoulder tolerates with no more than mild pain.
standing isometric shoulder flexion on w:
Steps
1. Face a wall with your elbow bent and your fist against it
2. Push your fist forward into the wall
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Push as hard as your shoulder tolerates with no more than mild pain.
standing isometric shoulder internal rot:
Steps
1. Stand in a doorframe, elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees, palm against the frame
2. Push your palm in towards your stomach
3. Hold for the set time
4. Relax and repeat

Tip
Push as hard as your shoulder tolerates with no more than mild pain.
standing keiser single arm external rota:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to the machine, holding the handle in the far hand
2. Put a rolled towel between your elbow and ribs
3. Rotate your forearm out
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
standing kettlebell hip flexor raise - 3:
Steps
1. Stand tall holding support, with a light kettlebell on the working foot
2. Lift your knee forward to hip height, then lower
3. Lift it out to the side, then lower
4. Lift it across your body, then lower

Tip
Stay upright and keep the standing leg straight.
standing miniband hip abduction:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your legs
2. Stand tall on one leg, holding support
3. Lift the other leg out to the side
4. Lower slowly, then switch

Tip
Mid-thigh is easiest, ankles hardest.
standing miniband hip flexor iso hold:
Steps
1. Place a mini band around your feet
2. Stand tall on one leg
3. Lift the other knee to hip height and hold
4. Lower and switch

Tip
Stay tall.
standing plate orbit:
Steps
1. Hold a plate with both hands at chest height
2. Circle the plate around your head
3. Keep your trunk still and ribs down
4. Reverse direction after each rep

Tip
Keep it close to your head.
standing shoulder flexion:
Steps
1. Stand tall with your arms by your sides
2. Raise one or both arms forward and up overhead
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
standing wall assisted miniband clam:
Steps
1. Stand side-on to a wall with a mini band above your knees
2. Lean your inside hip and knee on the wall
3. Rotate your outside knee out against the band
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep your hips square.
static distal hamstring stretch:
Steps
1. Put your heel up on a low step with the knee straight
2. Pull your toes towards you
3. Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Feel the stretch near the back of the knee.
static hip flexor stretch:
Steps
1. Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front
2. Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg
3. Shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Don't arch your lower back.
static lat and tricep stretch:
Steps
1. Reach one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head
2. Use the other hand to pull the elbow gently
3. Lean to the side slightly
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep your ribs down.
static lateral neck stretch:
Steps
1. Sit or stand tall
2. Tilt your ear towards your shoulder
3. Use your hand for gentle extra pressure if needed
4. Hold, then switch sides

Tip
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
static neck extension stretch:
Steps
1. Sit or stand tall
2. Slowly look up towards the ceiling
3. Hold the stretch gently
4. Return to neutral

Tip
Don't force it.
static neck flexion stretch:
Steps
1. Sit or stand tall
2. Tuck your chin towards your chest
3. Use your hands for gentle pressure if needed
4. Hold, then return

Tip
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
static oblique and lat stretch:
Steps
1. Stand with your feet hip-width apart
2. Reach one arm overhead
3. Lean to the opposite side
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep your hips still.
static quadricep stretch:
Steps
1. Stand holding support
2. Bend one knee and hold your foot behind you
3. Pull your heel towards your glute, knees together
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Squeeze your glute to feel more stretch.
static rear delt stretch:
Steps
1. Bring one arm across your chest
2. Hold it at the elbow with your other hand
3. Pull it gently towards your chest
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Keep your shoulder down.
suitcase carry:
Steps
1. Pick up a weight in one hand
2. Stand tall with your shoulders level
3. Walk for the set distance or time without leaning
4. Switch hands

Tip
Keep the weight away from your hips.
supine band hamstring tantrum:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your heels on a bench, band around your ankles anchored behind you
2. Lift your hips
3. Perform quick alternating heel digs against the band
4. Keep your hips up the whole time

Tip
Keep your glutes engaged.
supine cable hip flexion:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with an ankle strap attached to a low cable at your feet
2. Bend your knee and pull it towards your chest
3. Return slowly
4. Repeat, then switch

Tip
Keep your lower back flat.
supine dumbbell internal rotation - arm:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your arm out to the side, elbow at 90 degrees, holding a light dumbbell
2. Start with the forearm pointing back towards your head
3. Rotate it forward until it points to the ceiling
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Elbow stays on the floor.
supine knee rock:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, arms out to the sides
2. Let your knees fall slowly to one side
3. Bring them back to the middle and over to the other side
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
suspension mid row:
Steps
1. Hold the suspension handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Brace your body in a straight line
3. Pull your chest up to the handles
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
swiss ball cuban press:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on a Swiss ball holding light dumbbells
2. Row up until your elbows are at shoulder height
3. Rotate your forearms up
4. Press forward overhead, then reverse each step

Tip
Use a light weight.
swiss bar bench pull:
Steps
1. Lie chest down on a high bench with a Swiss bar on the floor below
2. Grip the neutral handles
3. Pull the bar up to the underside of the bench
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your chest on the bench.
swissball serratus wall push + circles:
Steps
1. Hold a Swiss ball against a wall at shoulder height with straight arms
2. Push into the ball
3. Make small circles with the ball while keeping the push
4. Reverse direction

Tip
Push into the ball throughout.
swissball tantrums:
Steps
1. Lie on your back with your heels on a Swiss ball
2. Lift your hips
3. Perform quick kicks into the ball, alternating legs
4. Keep your hips up

Tip
Pull your toes to your shins and kick with intent.
tibialis raise:
Steps
1. Stand with your back against a wall and your heels about a foot from it
2. Lift your toes as high as you can
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Keep your legs straight.
toe piano:
Steps
1. Stand barefoot
2. Lift all your toes, then lower them one at a time, starting with the little toe
3. Lift them one at a time, starting with the big toe
4. Repeat

Tip
Move each toe on its own.
towel curl press:
Steps
1. Hold a towel with both hands, pulling it apart
2. Curl it up towards your shoulders
3. Press it overhead
4. Reverse the movement

Tip
Keep tension on the towel throughout.
towel kettlebell supination:
Steps
1. Loop a towel through a kettlebell handle and hold both ends in one hand
2. Rest your forearm on your thigh
3. Rotate your palm up, lifting the bell
4. Lower slowly

Tip
Keep your forearm still.
towel taz:
Steps
1. Hold a towel at one end in each hand
2. Shake it as fast and as hard as you can
3. Keep going for the set time
4. Rest

Tip
Fast and hard on every rep.
trapbar drop catch:
Steps
1. Stand in a trap bar holding it at your hips
2. Let go of the handles
3. Quickly re-grip and catch the bar before it lands
4. Reset and repeat

Tip
Light weight. Keep a flat back.
trx i-y-t:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Pull your arms up into an I overhead
3. Return, then pull into a Y, then a T
4. Keep your body in a straight line

Tip
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
trx i-y-t - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold one TRX handle and lean back with a straight arm
2. Pull your arm overhead into an I
3. Return, then into a Y, then a T
4. Switch arms

Tip
Keep your body still.
trx t:
Steps
1. Hold the TRX handles and lean back with straight arms
2. Pull your arms out to the sides into a T
3. Squeeze your shoulder blades
4. Return slowly

Tip
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and collarbones wide.
underhand ez bar front raise:
Steps
1. Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip
2. Raise it forward to shoulder height with straight arms
3. Lower slowly
4. Repeat

Tip
Don't lean back.
upper calf stretch:
Steps
1. Stand facing a wall in a split stance with your hands on it
2. Keep your back leg straight and heel down
3. Lean in until you feel a stretch high in the back calf
4. Hold, then switch

Tip
Back knee stays straight.
waiters carry - single arm:
Steps
1. Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell overhead with a straight arm
2. Stand tall with your trunk braced
3. Walk for the set distance or time
4. Switch arms

Tip
Keep your bicep by your ear.
wall drills (3 point load and lift with:
Steps
1. Lean into a wall at about 45 degrees with your hands on it
2. Lift one knee into the A position
3. Load the down leg, then lift it into two quick switches
4. Hold the finishing position

Tip
Keep your body in a straight line.
wall sit:
Steps
1. Lean your back against a wall
2. Slide down until your knees are at about 90 degrees
3. Hold for the set time
4. Stand up slowly

Tip
Push your back into the wall.
weighted shoulder tap:
Steps
1. Start in a push-up position with a plate on your upper back
2. Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
3. Put it down and repeat on the other side
4. Keep your hips level

Tip
Widen your feet to make it easier.
zercher jefferson curl:
Steps
1. Hold a barbell in the crook of your elbows
2. Tuck your chin and roll down one segment of your spine at a time
3. Go as far as you can comfortably
4. Roll back up one segment at a time

Tip
Stay braced.
zottman curl:
Steps
1. Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms forward
2. Curl them up
3. Rotate your palms down at the top
4. Lower slowly, then rotate back

Tip
Keep your elbows by your sides.
